tasks.label: Process & Fix Truv JSON (Beelink)
tasks.command: curl -s -X POST http://192.168.50.194:8000/api/process-json -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d "{\"json_data\": $(cat ${file}), \"filename\": \"${fileBasename}\"}" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print('\nErrors:', d.get('validation_errors',[])); open('${fileDirname}/${fileBasenameNoExtension}.fixed.json','w').write(json.dumps(d.get('anon_json',{}), indent=2)); print('Saved: ${fileBasenameNoExtension}.fixed.json')"
